inputs.name: GithubOwnerService.constructor.options
inputs.description: The options object supplies the grant service, installation-token service, GitHub API adapter, and numeric GitHub App id used by the instance. The three service values are injected instances and are not constructed or validated here.

inputs.name: GithubOwnerService.authorizeRepository.actor
inputs.description: The authenticated collaboration actor passed to the GitHub grant service to retrieve that actor's user token. The service does not inspect or modify the actor fields.

inputs.name: GithubOwnerService.authorizeRepository.repositoryId
inputs.description: The GitHub numeric repository id to authorize; it must be a positive safe integer or the service rejects with repository-denied.

inputs.name: GithubOwnerService.repositories.actor
inputs.description: The authenticated collaboration actor whose user token scopes repository discovery and admin checks. The service passes it to the grant service without inspecting its fields.

outputs.name: GithubOwnerService.authorizeRepository
outputs.description: The GitHub identity for the requested repository, including the installation that proved app access. It resolves only after the actor's token reaches that repository and GitHub reports admin true for the same repository id.

outputs.name: GithubOwnerService.repositories
outputs.description: The repositories this actor administers in installations reachable by the app, with a flag for collection truncation. It examines at most 10 installations and 3 pages of 100 repositories per installation, and marks truncation when the observed list counts exceed those bounds.

errors.name: AuthFailure
errors.description: The service throws repository-denied for invalid repository ids, when no installation resolves the id, or when the actor lacks admin access. The grant service or GitHub API can also reject with github-not-connected or github-unavailable.
